properties.name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands
primary_causes: Coseismic tectonic subsidence following 2004 megathrust earthquake submerging coastal land under high tides
Torrential tropical rainfall eroding cleared undulating slopes.
properties.prevention_measures: Mangrove regeneration in inundated tidal zones; multi-tier coconut-spices agroforestry; contour bunding.

properties.name: Andhra Pradesh
primary_causes: Aridity and recurring drought in Rayalaseema districts (Ananthapuramu)
Heavy topsoil sheet wash in Eastern Ghats
Coastal aquaculture runoff causing localized salinity
properties.prevention_measures: Andhra Pradesh Community-managed Natural Farming (APCNF); percolation tanks; bio-fencing and zero tillage practices.

properties.name: Arunachal Pradesh
primary_causes: Seismically active steep mountain slopes vulnerable to torrential downpours
Linear infrastructure cutting across sensitive geologies
Shifting cultivation in lower foothill valleys.
properties.prevention_measures: Bio-turfing and hydroseeding on cut road slopes; community-based sacred grove conservation; sustainable cardamom agroforestry.
active_schemes: National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change (NAFCC)

properties.name: Assam
primary_causes: Severe braided channel migration and riverbank erosion along the Brahmaputra and Barak rivers
Annual catastrophic monsoon flooding carrying coarse silt
Shifting cultivation on Karbi Anglong and Dima Hasao hill slopes
properties.prevention_measures: Porcupine and geotextile revetment along vulnerable river banks; vetiver bio-fencing on dykes; agroforestry on elevated platforms.
active_schemes: Chief Minister's Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana
Assam Project on Forest and Biodiversity Conservation (APFBC)
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Assam Remote Sensing Application Centre (ARSAC)

properties.name: Bihar
primary_causes: Recurring flood inundation in Kosi, Gandak and Bagmati river basins
Topsoil deposition of coarse unproductive flood sand
Water stagnation in saucer-shaped chaurs and tals
properties.prevention_measures: Drainage syphon construction; integration of aquaculture and fox nut (Makhana) in permanent wetlands; sand-casting reclamation by silt enrichment.
active_schemes: Bihar Kosi Basin Development Project (World Bank)

properties.name: Chandigarh
primary_causes: Urban footprint expansion
Soil siltation from degraded Shivalik hills into Sukhna Lake catchment.
properties.prevention_measures: Catchment silt-retention dams in Sukhna Wildlife Sanctuary; strict urban green cover zoning.

properties.name: Chhattisgarh
primary_causes: Extensive open-cast coal, iron, and bauxite mining in Korba, Dantewada, and Raigarh
Deforestation and forest fragmentation
Heavy runoff on degraded red and yellow lateritic soils.
properties.prevention_measures: Compulsory compensatory afforestation; gully plugging using loose boulder structures; bio-fertilizer and compost promotion.
active_schemes: Suraji Gaon Yojana (Narwa, Garuwa, Ghurwa, Bari)

properties.name: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
primary_causes: Coastal proximity and tidal ingress in Daman and Diu
High industrial development density in Dadra & Nagar Haveli.
properties.prevention_measures: Mangrove restoration on tidal mudflats; industrial effluent monitoring; coastal bunding.

properties.name: NCT of Delhi
primary_causes: Rapid urban sprawl replacing fertile Yamuna alluvium with concrete and asphalt
Over-extraction of groundwater causing soil subsidence
Encroachment on the ecologically vital Aravalli Ridge.
properties.prevention_measures: Mandatory rainwater harvesting injection wells in all urban buildings; development of biodiversity parks (Yamuna and Aravalli Biodiversity Parks); permeable pavement construction.

properties.name: Goa
primary_causes: Historical iron and manganese ore mine tailings along Zuari and Mandovi river basins
Coastal beach sand erosion due to sea wall construction and tourism footprints.
properties.prevention_measures: Bio-stabilization of mine reject terraces with acacia and bamboo; revival of traditional Khazan dyke and sluice gate agriculture; coastal dune vegetation conservation.

properties.name: Gujarat
primary_causes: Seawater ingress along 1,600 km coastline
Hyper-saline conditions in Rann of Kachchh and Banni grasslands
Over-extraction of coastal aquifers
properties.prevention_measures: Tidal regulators and bandharas along coastline; Prosopis juliflora eradication replaced with indigenous Salvadora and Acacia; halophyte plantation; laser land leveling.
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification & Land Degradation Atlas 2021

properties.name: Haryana
primary_causes: Inland basin geometry with no natural drainage outlet leading to rising saline water tables in Rohtak, Jhajjar, and Hisar
Wind drift along the Rajasthan border in Mahendragarh and Bhiwani
Intensive multi-cropping.
properties.prevention_measures: Sub-surface drainage (SSD) technology installed by ICAR-CSSRI; micro-sprinkler systems; solar water-lifting pumps; green manuring with Sesbania (Dhaincha).

properties.name: Himachal Pradesh
primary_causes: Glacial retreat, permafrost thaw and freeze-thaw rock shattering in Lahaul-Spiti and Kinnaur
Cloudbursts and high-intensity rainfall triggering flash landslides
Road construction debris disposal on unstable slopes
properties.prevention_measures: Bio-engineering slope stabilization using crib walls and native alder/poplar; check dam cascades; cold desert seabuckthorn (Hippophae rhamnoides) plantation.
active_schemes: HP Forest Eco-systems Climate Proofing Project (KFW)
Integrated Development Project for Source Sustainability and Climate Resilient Rain-fed Agriculture

properties.name: Jammu & Kashmir
primary_causes: Karewa sediment mining and slope excavation
Deforestation in Pir Panjal range
High-energy water runoff during spring snowmelt
properties.prevention_measures: Strict moratorium on illegal Karewa mining; catchment afforestation; terraced orchard management.

properties.name: Jharkhand
primary_causes: Open-cast coal, iron, and mica mining leaving vast abandoned overburden dumps
Severe rill and sheet erosion on Chota Nagpur Plateau undulating slopes
Degradation of Sal (Shorea robusta) forests
properties.prevention_measures: Gradonies and staggered contour trenches on plateau slopes; biological reclamation of mine dumps using vetiver grass and leguminous tree species; 5% model farm ponds (Doba).

properties.name: Karnataka
primary_causes: Dryland drought vulnerability across northern Karnataka (Deccan trap)
Topsoil runoff during erratic monsoons
Canal command waterlogging and salinization in Tungabhadra and Upper Krishna basin
properties.prevention_measures: Sujala watershed development models; contour bunding; horticulture integration with dryland crops (tamarind, amla); tank desilting.
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Atlas 2021 / Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre (KSRSAC)

properties.name: Kerala
properties.severity: Low by Area, Critical in Extreme Rainfall Events
primary_causes: High-intensity monsoon downpours on steep modified slopes of the Western Ghats (Idukki, Wayanad)
Loss of natural wetlands (paddy puncha lands) to urban construction
Coastal wave erosion.
properties.prevention_measures: Bio-terracing with Vetiver; conservation of Kuttanad below sea level heritage farming system; mangrove green wall restoration along coastal backwaters.
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Kerala State Remote Sensing and Environment Centre (KSREC)

properties.name: Lakshadweep
primary_causes: Coral reef degradation weakening wave buffering
Very thin freshwater lens resting on seawater, easily depleted by motorized pumps.
properties.prevention_measures: Bio-rock reef restoration; rainwater harvesting covering 100% of residential roofs; ban on coral mining.
active_schemes: Lakshadweep Desalination and Water Security Project
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / National Centre for Sustainable Coastal Management (NCSCM)

properties.name: Madhya Pradesh
primary_causes: Severe gully erosion forming Chambal badlands / ravines
Deforestation on fragile forest fringes
Overgrazing and opencast coal/iron mining in Singrauli & Jabalpur
properties.prevention_measures: Ravine reclamation using bamboo plantation and vegetative check dams; aerial seeding of degraded forest patches; participatory forest management.
active_schemes: Chambal Ravine Reclamation Project (with World Bank)

properties.name: Maharashtra
primary_causes: Monoculture of water-intensive cash crops (sugarcane) in rain-shadow regions
Over-irrigation in heavy black cotton soils causing secondary salinization
Soil loss on undulating Deccan Plateau
properties.prevention_measures: Broad-bed furrow cultivation; continuous contour trenching (CCT); watershed treatment via ridge-to-valley approach; farm ponds; sub-surface drainage in canal commands.
properties.data_source: ISRO Space Applications Centre (SAC) Desertification Atlas 2021

properties.name: Manipur
primary_causes: Shifting cultivation on hill districts (Churachandpur, Senapati)
Encroachment and silt accumulation in Loktak Lake catchment area.
properties.prevention_measures: Catchment protection planting; terraced rice cultivation; settled agroforestry.
active_schemes: National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem

properties.name: Meghalaya
primary_causes: Unscientific rat-hole coal and limestone mining releasing toxic acidic leachate
Intense rainfall (highest in the world at Mawsynram/Sohra) stripping exposed soil on deforested plateau slopes.
properties.prevention_measures: Phytoremediation with acid-tolerant reeds and biochar; strict regulation of artisanal mining; bamboo drip irrigation systems.
active_schemes: Meghalaya Community Led Landscapes Management Project (CLLMP - World Bank)
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / NESAC Umiam

properties.name: Mizoram
primary_causes: Shifting slash-and-burn cultivation on fragile shale and sandstone slopes
Bamboo gregarious flowering and subsequent soil exposure during die-back.
properties.prevention_measures: New Land Use Policy (NLUP) promoting permanent horticulture (passion fruit, dragon fruit, rubber); contour bunding; community reserve forests.

properties.name: Nagaland
primary_causes: Shortening of traditional Jhum (slash-and-burn) cycle from 15-20 years to 3-5 years due to population pressure
Steep slope deforestation causing massive topsoil runoff during monsoons.
properties.prevention_measures: Agro-forestry based settled farming with nitrogen-fixing Alder trees (Alnus nepalensis); terrace cultivation; Community Conserved Areas (CCAs).

properties.name: Odisha
primary_causes: Shifting cultivation (Podu chasa) in southern tribal highlands
High-intensity coastal cyclones causing coastal erosion and sea surge
Extensive iron-ore, bauxite and chromite mining in Keonjhar and Sukinda
properties.prevention_measures: Transition from Podu to settled agroforestry (cashew, coffee, mango); mangrove belt restoration along Kendrapara coast; mine dump stabilization with geotextiles.
active_schemes: Odisha Forestry Sector Development Project (OFSDP - JICA)
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Odisha Space Applications Centre (ORSAC)

properties.name: Puducherry
primary_causes: Excessive pumping of groundwater in coastal aquifers leading to seawater intrusion
Disruption of longshore drift by harbour breakwaters.
properties.prevention_measures: Submerged offshore reef construction; recharge shafts; micro-irrigation using treated wastewater.

properties.name: Punjab
properties.severity: Low by Area, Critical by Agronomic Intensity
primary_causes: Paddy-wheat mono-cropping rotation causing catastrophic groundwater drawdown and nutrient mining
Canal seepage and rising saline water table in Muktsar, Fazilka, and Bathinda
Intensive pesticide and chemical fertilizer application
properties.prevention_measures: Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) technique; sub-surface drainage systems to flush out salts; crop diversification into maize, pulses and oilseeds; laser land leveling.
active_schemes: Promotion of Agricultural Mechanization for In-Situ Management of Crop Residue
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Punjab Remote Sensing Centre (PRSC)

properties.name: Rajasthan
primary_causes: Aridity and hyper-arid climate in Thar Desert
Overgrazing by high livestock density
Depletion of deep fossil groundwater
Wind deflation of active sand dunes
properties.prevention_measures: Shelterbelt plantations using Prosopis cineraria (Khejri) and Acacia tortilis; sand dune stabilization with micro-windbreaks; pressurized drip irrigation along Indira Gandhi Canal; silvopastoral grazing management.
active_schemes: Green Wall of India Project (Aravalli Range)
properties.data_source: ISRO Space Applications Centre (SAC) Desertification Atlas 2021

properties.name: Sikkim
primary_causes: High-energy Teesta river canyon runoff
Glacial lake expansion and moraine instability in North Sikkim.
properties.prevention_measures: Complete state-wide organic agriculture eliminating synthetic chemical inputs; Dhara Vikas spring rejuvenation; slope drainage chutes.
active_schemes: National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem

properties.name: Tamil Nadu
primary_causes: Soil erosion in Nilgiris and Palani hills due to plantation slopes
Over-exploitation of hard-rock groundwater aquifers
Coastal salinity intrusion in Cauvery Delta
properties.prevention_measures: Bench terracing on tea and coffee estates; check dam networks; community tank rehabilitation (Kudimaramath); Vetiver hedgerows for slope stabilization.
active_schemes: Tamil Nadu Irrigated Agriculture Modernization Project (TNIAMP)

properties.name: Tripura
primary_causes: Intensive brick kiln topsoil excavation in valley floors
Rubber monoculture replacing diverse native tropical moist forests
Jhum cultivation on hill slopes.
properties.prevention_measures: Agro-forestry with intercropping; systematic soil regeneration on abandoned brick fields; contour terracing.
active_schemes: Indo-German Development Cooperation Project on Climate Change Adaptation in Tripura

properties.name: Uttar Pradesh
primary_causes: Geogenic sodium accumulation creating hard sodic Usar crusts in central alluvium
Flat gradient and poor canal drainage leading to waterlogging
Sheet and gully erosion in Bundelkhand rocky terrain
properties.prevention_measures: Chemical reclamation with mineral gypsum and press-mud; salt-tolerant varieties (CSR 30 rice, KRL 210 wheat); drainage interceptors; Bundelkhand farm pond missions.
active_schemes: UP Sodic Land Reclamation Project (UPSLRP III - World Bank)
Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Kisan Samriddhi Yojana
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / Remote Sensing Applications Centre UP (RSAC-UP)

properties.name: Uttarakhand
primary_causes: Tectonic fragility of the Main Central Thrust and Main Boundary Thrust
Heavy torrential monsoons causing gully formation and slope collapse
Forest fires during dry pre-monsoon months damaging ground litter
properties.prevention_measures: Springshed management (Dhara Vikas); check dam construction; geogrid slope revetment; Oak forest conservation for water retention.

properties.name: West Bengal
primary_causes: Cyclone breaches of coastal mud embankments flooding paddy fields with seawater
Lateritic soil erosion in Purulia and Bankura drylands
Riverbank collapse along Bhagirathi-Hooghly
properties.prevention_measures: Geo-tube reinforced embankment construction; mangrove afforestation along tidal edges; salt-tolerant indigenous rice varieties (Pokkali, Hamilton).
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Atlas 2021 / West Bengal State Council of Science & Technology

properties.name: Telangana
primary_causes: Dry deciduous scrub degradation in semi-arid zones
Monoculture of Bt cotton on rainfed red chalka soils
Over-reliance on borewell irrigation in granitic terrain
properties.prevention_measures: Massive revival of historic irrigation cascades (chain tanks); Telanganaku Haritha Haram mass afforestation; subsoiling to break hardpan.
properties.data_source: ISRO SAC Desertification Atlas 2021 / TRAC Telangana

properties.name: Ladakh
primary_causes: Extremely arid climate with annual precipitation < 100 mm
High solar ultraviolet radiation degrading organic matter
Rapid permafrost thaw due to warming climate

dominant_processes.type: Frost Shattering & Cold Desert Bare Soil

properties.prevention_measures: Artificial ice stupas / artificial glaciers for springtime irrigation meltwater; seabuckthorn planting along stream banks; trench composting.
